=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15220-15246 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_standalone_stall_recovery_skips_when_phase_attempts_exhausted still asserts `"ai:closed" in result["issues"]["501"]["labels"]` (line 15245) and passes no `env_overrides={"STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED": "false"}`, but the PR turns the breaker on by default (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh ~2906), so the standalone `skip)` arm now adds ai:needs-human and leaves the issue open.
  WHY: CI confirms the failure (orchestrate-poll shard 3, run 40849683814, job 123365756141, "35 passed, 1 failed"), which also fails the aggregate lint gate; the sibling test test_standalone_stall_exhaustion_reports_phase_attempts_not_reset_counter got the switch-off override (line 15275) and this one did not; all reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22634-22699 (run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker); scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1544-1558, 2355-2357, 2379-2380 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the managed breaker trips, it applies ai:plan-failed or ai:clarify-failed. Both labels are in TERMINAL_PHASES, so reconcile_wave_issue_status records the wave issue as "closed" for good (stored terminal status never regresses), and check-wave-status counts it as failed and finished.
  WHY: This brings back the legacy skip-and-close for managed issues: the wave advances with a gap, and after the unblock judge removes the label and resumes the issue, the wave status stays "closed". test_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker_trips_and_label_survives_next_tick never checks the wave issue status on the second tick. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22634-22639 (_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply, comment POST failure branch) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If posting the breaker comment (the `AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_V1` consumption marker) fails, the function logs `outcome=comment_failed` but still returns 0 and reports tripped, so the failure label is applied and the pre-trip markers are never consumed.
  WHY: After the unblock judge removes the failure label and posts /reclarify (scripts/unblock_actions.py:748-750), the next tick re-evaluates the same unconsumed markers, trips again and re-applies the label. The resumed work is blocked in a loop. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23110-23119 (run_standalone_stall_recovery breaker `trip)` arm) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `continue` runs unconditionally, including when _failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply returns 1 (outcome=label_failed). That skips the capacity-wait, threshold and legacy recovery ladder for the issue. The managed loop only skips on success (`|| continue`).
  WHY: While label edits keep failing, a standalone issue gets neither the breaker label nor legacy stall recovery on every tick, which contradicts the README "Stall recovery: failure-signature breaker" contract. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR, and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it both MAJOR (an item citing 22634-22639 that blames the caller's `continue`) and NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT. The highest rating (MAJOR) is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_PER_ISSUE` is exhausted, both the standalone and the managed stall loops now add `ai:needs-human`, verify it, comment the recovery history and leave the issue and its linked PR open for the unblock judge … instead of closing both with `ai:closed`." (changelog.d/stuck-states-p3b-stall-breaker.md)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the standalone `skip)` arm of run_standalone_stall_recovery (~24080-24139) and the managed `skip` arm (~19356-19393)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The implementation is present, but test_standalone_stall_recovery_skips_when_phase_attempts_exhausted (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15220-15246) was not updated and still asserts the legacy ai:closed. CI fails, so no passing test locks in the new default.
- requirement: "When the same `AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1` (phase, fingerprint) repeats `STALL_FINGERPRINT_REPEAT_MAX` times in a row", the breaker labels the issue and verifies the label before the breaker comment is posted (README "Stall recovery: failure-signature breaker" section)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh _failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply (~22600-22665), the block that posts the breaker comment
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: If the breaker comment fails to post after the label was applied, the code returns success and the consumption marker is missing, so a later unblock-judge relabel trips the breaker again indefinitely. The comment needs a retry, or a guard that reports the failure as label_failed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15220-15246 (_run_poller call 15233-15240; assertion line 15245) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The default-on STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, near line 2906) makes the standalone `skip)` arm add ai:needs-human instead of ai:closed. This test (phase_attempts {"ai:review-blocked": 5}) was not given the switch-off override that its sibling test got.
  WHY: The assertion at line 15245 fails (orchestrate-poll shard 3, run 40849683814), and the aggregate lint job fails. Fix: add `env_overrides={"STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED": "false"}` at lines 15233-15240.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker); scripts/orchestrate_lib.py TERMINAL_PHASES 1544-1551, PHASE_LABELS_PRIORITY 1517-1519, reconcile_wave_issue_status 2379-2380 / 2355-2357, check-wave-status 3651-3652, 3664 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The managed trip applies FFB_LABEL (ai:plan-failed or ai:clarify-failed), which is a terminal phase, so the wave issue is recorded as "closed" for good. The managed jq selector (~22717) and the stall guard (STALL_SKIP reason=terminal_state, 24499-24504) then drop it.
  WHY: The wave treats the issue as failed and finished. After the unblock judge resumes it (scripts/unblock_actions.py lines 748-750), the status stays "closed" and is never tracked again. The managed test does not assert the second-tick wave status. Fix: apply ai:needs-human when ffb_scope=managed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply (comment POST failure branch → `outcome=tripped`, `return 0`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed breaker-comment POST still returns 0, so the markers are never consumed.
  WHY: After a /reclarify resume, the next tick re-trips on the stale markers (the standalone loop skips `ai:*-failed` at line 23070), so the judge and breaker cycle. Fix: return 1 or retry the comment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23110-23119 (run_standalone_stall_recovery `trip)` arm) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `continue` also runs when the apply returns 1 (label_failed), which skips capacity-wait, threshold and the recovery ladder.
  WHY: This contradicts the README contract that "the legacy ladder keeps running and the next tick retries". Fix: move `continue` inside the `if`.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: move `continue` inside the success branch (23111-23118); `return 1` after the comment_failed warning; assert second["latest_state"]["waves"][0]["issues"][0]["status"] not in ("closed", "skipped"). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3 (3 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
